title: Tim Knight Says Fewer and Fewer Stocks Are Carrying This Whole Market
speaker: Tim Knight (Slope of Hope) on tastylive

macro_themes.view: Fewer and fewer stocks (e.g. Micron) are carrying the market; breadth at war lows - something has to give.
VIX in the mid-teens is too low; expects a surprise and a psychological/volatility inflection around the Nov 3 election.
Equities rising despite rates going up almost daily; a relief rally in rate-sensitive assets (XLU, XLF, TLT) could even push equities higher.

calls.condition: Bulls are in control until price slips back below the breakout line (prior high).
calls.reason: NQ closed above the prior high on Friday and padded gains since; he finds nothing bearish on QQQ/NVDA/SMH charts except that they are high.
calls.quote: the bulls control this until they don't until it slunks below that yellow line which may or may not happen.

calls.reason: Stunned how low volatility is in the mid-teens; expects a surprise between now and year-end around the election.
calls.quote: I think you're in for a surprise between now and the end of the year.

calls.condition: A break below Friday's low (~791.75) would complete failure of the symmetric triangle and could accelerate the drop.
calls.reason: Island reversal top on lifetime-high day; shorted in size yesterday; down ~8% today.
calls.quote: I shorted this in size yesterday not because it was some amazing pattern but I felt that uh something's up with this

calls.reason: Better-looking short pattern than STX with a well-defined ~400 support; down ~50% from summer and still a dynamite short.
calls.quote: it just goes to show you can have a stock down 50% and it's still a dynamite short. So I might just get into this …

calls.reason: Still chugging along after a big rally but getting long in the tooth; profit taking likely; crucial support ~150 for the rest of the year.
calls.quote: It's probably getting close to some profit taking here

calls.reason: Shorted after an explosive one-day rally on the Brazil first-round election result; shooting star; ambitious target is filling the price gap below.
calls.quote: So I shorted EWC. Um it had just exploded higher

calls.reason: Down ~4.5% even with semis up - relative weakness; if semiconductors sell off the leveraged fund accelerates down; stop tightened.
calls.quote: if semiconductors do start to sell off the acceleration downward of this is going to be a sight to see.
